name: moderate-level-3-pool-cuts-lifted
notes: The same Moderate level 3 budget the ladder spends, drawn from a bag with the pool's plausibility and genre cuts lifted and its coverage floor dropped to Diminished. The instrument for #312 - thirty fights contain no enemy magic because every CR <= 4 caster is filtered out, and nothing today can ask what the ladder would look like if they were admitted. Numbers taken from this scenario describe a game we do not ship, and any batch quoting them must say so.
